using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Ferrule.Generated;
using Ferrule.Runtime;

static object Typed(FerruleInstance node) => node switch
{
    FerruleGroup group => new { kind = "group", fields = group.Fields.Select(field => new { name = field.Name, value = Typed(field.Value) }).ToArray() },
    FerruleRepeated repeated => new { kind = "repeated", items = repeated.Items.Select(Typed).ToArray() },
    FerruleScalar scalar => new { kind = scalar.Value.Kind.ToString(), value = scalar.Value.Kind switch {
        FerruleValueKind.Int64 => (object?)scalar.Value.Int64Value,
        FerruleValueKind.String => scalar.Value.StringValue,
        _ => null,
    } },
    _ => throw new Exception("Unexpected mapped instance shape"),
};

static void Verify(FerruleInstance actual, JsonElement expected)
{
    switch (expected.ValueKind)
    {
        case JsonValueKind.Object:
            if (actual is not FerruleGroup group || group.Fields.Count != expected.EnumerateObject().Count()) throw new Exception("Whole group differs");
            foreach (var field in expected.EnumerateObject()) Verify(group.Fields.Single(item => item.Name == field.Name).Value, field.Value);
            break;
        case JsonValueKind.Array:
            if (actual is not FerruleRepeated repeated || repeated.Items.Count != expected.GetArrayLength()) throw new Exception("Whole sequence differs");
            for (int index = 0; index < repeated.Items.Count; index++) Verify(repeated.Items[index], expected[index]);
            break;
        case JsonValueKind.Number:
            if (actual is not FerruleScalar number || number.Value.Kind != FerruleValueKind.Int64 || number.Value.Int64Value != expected.GetInt64()) throw new Exception("Integer count differs");
            break;
        case JsonValueKind.String:
            if (actual is not FerruleScalar text || text.Value.Kind != FerruleValueKind.String || text.Value.StringValue != expected.GetString()) throw new Exception("String differs");
            break;
        default: throw new Exception("Outside authored output domain");
    }
}

static void Refuses(Action action, JsonElement test, string boundary)
{
    try { action(); }
    catch (FerruleXmlBoundaryException error)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = test.GetProperty("name").GetString(), boundary, stage = "input", category = error.Kind.ToString(), error = error.ToString() }));
        if (error.Kind.ToString() != test.GetProperty("runtimeCategory").GetString()) throw new Exception("Wrong XML error category", error);
        return;
    }
    catch (FerruleX12Exception error)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = test.GetProperty("name").GetString(), boundary, stage = "input", category = error.Error.ToString(), error = error.ToString() }));
        if (error.Error.ToString() != test.GetProperty("runtimeCategory").GetString()) throw new Exception("Wrong X12 error category", error);
        return;
    }
    throw new Exception("Invalid input reached mapping");
}

string source = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "source-schema.json"));
string target = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "target-schema.json"));
string kind = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "input-kind.txt"));
using var cases = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "cases.json")));
foreach (var test in cases.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
{
    string document = test.GetProperty("input").GetString()!;
    FerruleInstance Text() => kind switch {
        "xml" => FerruleXml.ParseStructuredEmbedded(source, document),
        "x12" => FerruleX12.ParseEmbedded(source, document),
        _ => throw new Exception("Unknown authored input cohort"),
    };
    FerruleInstance Bytes() => kind switch {
        "xml" => FerruleXml.ParseStructuredEmbeddedBytes(source, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(document)),
        "x12" => FerruleX12.ParseEmbeddedBytes(source, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(document)),
        _ => throw new Exception("Unknown authored input cohort"),
    };
    if (test.TryGetProperty("reject", out var reject) && reject.GetBoolean())
    {
        if (test.GetProperty("stage").GetString() != "input") throw new Exception("Wrong expected error stage");
        Refuses(() => Text(), test, "text");
        Refuses(() => Bytes(), test, "utf8");
        continue;
    }
    foreach (var (boundary, input) in new[] {
        ("text", Text()),
        ("utf8", Bytes()),
    })
    {
        FerruleInstance output;
        try { output = GeneratedMapping.Execute(input); }
        catch (Exception error) { Console.Error.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = test.GetProperty("name").GetString(), boundary, stage = "mapping", error = error.ToString() })); throw; }
        Console.Error.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = test.GetProperty("name").GetString(), boundary, typed = Typed(output) }));
        string json = FerruleJson.SerializeEmbedded(target, output);
        Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = test.GetProperty("name").GetString(), boundary, stage = "mapping", output = JsonNode.Parse(json) }));
        Verify(output, test.GetProperty("expected"));
        if (!JsonNode.DeepEquals(JsonNode.Parse(json), JsonNode.Parse(test.GetProperty("expected").GetRawText()))) throw new Exception($"Whole output differs: {json}");
    }
}
Console.WriteLine($"filtered-count {kind} Release cases: {cases.RootElement.GetArrayLength()}");
